# HUMAN001 human-review-stale

A screen that needs a human review has a current, trusted ack in `crunk.lock`. Each block is one
source file in a project whose `crunk.toml` is the default preset plus one reviewed screen `home`;
the case's `config` selects the recorded review (none, current, or recorded before a token
changed).

## What it does

For every screen state that requires review (`review = "human"`, or `provenance = "agent"` without
`review = "skip"`), compares the digest of its inputs (the spec entry, the declared sources, the
resolved tokens the sources use per mode, the fonts, the render when one exists) with the digest
in its `[[review]]` entry. A missing entry, a changed digest, a reviewer outside `[review]
reviewers`, or (with `require_signed`) an ack introduced by an unsigned commit or a key not listed
for the reviewer is a finding that names the screen and what changed. It is Advisory in `crunk
check` and CI; at the release gate (`crunk check --gate release`) it is Error.

## Why it matters

An agent-built screen that nobody looked at, or a screen reviewed before its tokens moved, is the
unreviewed design change the lock exists to stop.

## Remedy

Run `crunk review` to see the queue, look at each screen, then `crunk ack SUBJECT` (a person, at a
terminal) to record the new digest, and commit `crunk.lock`.

## Examples

### A reviewed screen with no recorded review fires

```css expect=fire config=review-missing file=styles/app.css
.a {
  margin: 0;
}
```

### A review recorded before a token changed fires

```css expect=fire config=review-stale file=styles/app.css
.a {
  margin: 0;
}
```

### A current approved review is clean

```css expect=clean config=review-current file=styles/app.css
.a {
  margin: 0;
}
```

### A review by someone off the allow-list fires

```css expect=fire config=review-unlisted file=styles/app.css
.a {
  margin: 0;
}
```

### An ack in an unsigned commit fires when signatures are required

```css expect=fire config=review-unsigned file=styles/app.css
.a {
  margin: 0;
}
```
